d: Jharkhand vidhanasbha ke vistarit satr ke dauran esaaaeeaar par charcha ko lekar satta paksh aur vipaksh ke bich tikhi bahas dekhne ko mili. sadan men pradip yadav ke bayan par neta pratipaksh babulal marandi ne palatvar karte hue kaha ki loktantr ki majbuti ke lie matdata suchi ki shuddhata anivary shart hai. vahin, rojgar aur bharti ghotale ke mudde par endie ke vidhaykon ne vidhanasbha parisar men pradarshan kiya. pradarshankariyon ne bharti prakriyaon men kathit aniymittaon ki sibiaaee janch karane ki mang ki aur rajy sarkar par yuvaon ke hiton ki andekhi karne ka aarop lagaya. dusri…
